Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3641 BBY]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] named [[Zirchros]] had a personal '''medical facility'''. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], the Hutt was 1,700 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old and was [[Death/Legends|dying]] inside of the [[Medcenter/Legends|facility]]. While Zirchros was at the facility he told individuals stories of the early days of the criminal underworld of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
One individual came to the facility to talk to Zirchros and stayed with the Hutt for some time. Eventually the individual learned information about a secret cache of cultural arifacts from an extinct [[Unidentified civilization (Zirchros)|civilization]] that Zirchros's [[Zirchros's father|father]] had owned before him. After spending time with the dying Hutt at the medical facility, the individual obtained the artifacts and returned them to an ally.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zirchros's medical facility was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]]. It was featured in the archaeology crew skill mission entitled "Memoirs of a Crimelord" which was available for players of both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and Republic factions. In a crew skill mission, the player would send one of their companions to complete the mission, but due to the mission being available to all classes it was unknown who went to the facility. As a reward for the mission, the player received some lost artifact fragments.<ref name="TOR" />
